status: provisional pixel-reviewed grids; automatic envelope proposals
method: Hand-set cells/row sequences from page pixels; independent connected-ink envelopes inside cells; page overlay reviewed.
limitations: Envelopes are provisional, not certified character transcriptions.
Nested navigation panels have independent row/column indices; no fictitious shared row phase is imposed.
Faint punctuation, touching rules and stamps can affect automatic envelope proposals.

tables.notes: Annotation is mapped back to original pixels; no orientation correction is applied to detector output.
